widgets_values:
Vertical 9:16, 15 seconds, four shots, hard cuts.
Event: six axe-gang men march in two columns, ground their axes, and issue a challenge; Xiaozheng is shoved off balance into the corn pile; Chen Bo sets down his mug and lifts his eyes.
Shot 1 (0—4s): low wide angle. At the end of the dirt road, six men in black suits and fedoras march in two columns, in step, each holding a short axe at his thigh; inside the locust-tree shadow they raise the axes together, six blades forming one reflected line across the lens, dust rising at their heels.
Shot 2 (4—8s): medium. The leader (<Picture 6>, identity locked) halts at the front, brim low to the brow, takes off his hat and fans it across his chest, flat Mandarin: “吴家村，谁管事儿？叫个能打的出来。” Six axes strike the ground together, one low thud, a ring of dust.
Shot 3 (8—12s): cut to the doorstep. Haima (<Picture 5>) shells peanuts, eyes down, Luxi drawl: “恁这一套，俺们赶集见得多嘞。” Xiaozheng (<Picture 3>) rushes in from the side; two gang members cross their axe handles to block and shove; his feet slip and he slides into the corn pile on the right, two cobs rolling off.
Shot 4 (12—15s): close on the bamboo chair, 0.5× slow motion. Chen Bo (<Picture 1>) sets the enamel mug down, a wooden tap; palm on knee, he slowly raises his eyes. Behind his shoulder, six blade edges line up into one bright streak. He says nothing.
Camera/light: fixed wall, corn pile, chair; column always in the right third; warm low sun, sharp blade highlights, visible dust.
Sound: marching feet, the low six-axe thud, cicadas, chickens, horn hum; lip-sync; no music.
Stability: six men fixed, no additions or swaps; exactly six axes; one fall only.
